overview_description.description: Melio is a fintech company that delivers a digital accounts payable and receivable platform tailored for small and medium-sized businesses. The platform enables users to pay invoices via ACH, credit/debit cards, or checks, and to receive payments through bank transfers or mailed checks, all from a unified dashboard. It integrates with accounting software like QuickBooks, Xero, FreshBooks, and Shopify, enabling streamlined bookkeeping and cash flow management. Melio adds features like user permissions, recurring and batch payments, virtual cards, real-time payments, and a buy‑now‑pay‑later option to offer flexible vendor payment options.

product.name: Accounts Payable Platform
product.description: A digital platform that automates and manages business bill payments, offering multiple payment methods and cash flow control.

product.name: Accounts Receivable Platform
product.description: A service that allows businesses to send payment links to customers and receive payments directly to their bank accounts securely and quickly.

product.name: Accounting Firms Solution
product.description: A platform tailored for accounting firms to manage multiple clients’ accounts payable and receivable with automation and control features.

product.name: Auto Bill Capture
product.description: An AI-powered tool that scans, imports, or receives invoices to automate data entry into the payment platform.

product.name: W-9 Collection and 1099 Sync
product.description: Tools to collect W-9 forms from contractors and automatically sync 1099 filing data with tax services.

product.name: Pay by Card
product.description: A payment method allowing businesses to pay vendors using credit cards even where cards are not typically accepted.
